raw_record.question_text: Find the measure of $∠A$ to the nearest tenth.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a right triangle ABC with the right angle marked at C, vertical leg BC labeled 6, and horizontal leg CA labeled 20. The text asks for the measure of angle A to the nearest tenth. Since relative to angle A the opposite side is BC=6 and the adjacent side is CA=20, use the tangent ratio: tan(A)=opposite/adjacent=6/20. Then compute A=arctan(0.3) and round to the nearest tenth, giving 16.7 degrees.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，点 C 处有直角标记。线段 BC 是竖直边，标为 6；线段 CA 是水平边，标为 20；点 A 在右端，要求 ∠A 的度数。

推理：相对于 ∠A，BC=6 是对边，CA=20 是邻边。使用正切比：tan(A)=对边/邻边=6/20=0.3。因此 A=arctan(0.3)≈16.699°，四舍五入到最接近的十分位为 16.7°。
